name: Philippines
sources: CPI inflation 12.18% and lending interest rate 24.12% (World Bank, 1990). The rate is that high because the Central Bank was defending the peso through a balance-of-payments crisis that ended in a standby arrangement with the IMF in February 1991.
Defence 2.15% of GDP (World Bank/SIPRI, 1990) — low for a state fighting two insurgencies at once, and it is the transcribed figure.
National government debt near 68% of GDP: the Marcos-era external debt was never repudiated, and servicing it consumed roughly a third of the budget through the period.

tfp_trend 0.008 is deliberately the lowest in the region. 1990 is the year the Philippine growth story stalled: a 7.8 earthquake in July killed 1,600 in Luzon, Mount Pinatubo followed in 1991, the Gulf war took the oil price up and remittances from Kuwait down, and the December 1989 coup attempt had already frightened off the investment.

Stability 35: Corazon Aquino faced seven coup attempts between 1986 and 1990, the largest of them a month before the game opens, put down with American air cover from Clark. The Senate voted the bases out in September 1991.

separatism 0.24 is the Moro National Liberation Front and the autonomous region in Muslim Mindanao created in 1989. It excludes the CPP-NPA insurgency, which was nationwide and revolutionary rather than territorial.
Military index 4: roughly 106,000 in the Armed Forces of the Philippines, an infantry force fully committed at home, with an air force and navy of largely 1940s-1950s American origin.
Gross capital formation 23.3% of GDP (World Bank, 1990), entered as 5 state and 18 private.

Series check, August 2026, read from the World Bank API: NY.GDP.MKTP.CD 1990 = 50,508,286,642; SP.POP.TOTL = 62,854,666; FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG = 12.177; FR.INR.LEND = 24.118; MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS = 2.147; NE.GDI.TOTL.ZS = 23.332. All match. National government debt near 68% of GDP is not on those series and is not verified here.

pop_growth_1990 = 2.6610%/yr. Compound annual growth of World Bank SP.POP.TOTL, series PHL (Philippines): 53,726,181 in 1984 to 61,265,260 in 1989 — the five years ending on the eve of the 1 January 1990 start date. See EconomyRecord::pop_growth_1990 in spheres-sim/src/data/mod.rs for why the window ends in 1989 and not with the single-year 1990 rate.

note: 1990 TECHNOLOGY: AUTHORED, NOT DERIVED. What this nation knew on 1 January 1990 is transcribed and sourced grant by grant, exactly like every other 1990 figure in this file, and is not read off tfp_trend - there was never a code path from the trend to the known set, and the zero that stood there was a claim about the world rather than an absence of one (BIBLE section 8 and iron rule 4, both amended 2026-08-30). THE PREDICATE IS SPLIT, and split by the technology's OWN EFFECT TYPE so that it is mechanically computable and never a per-nation judgement call. A node whose effects include MilitaryEfficiency, MilitaryStrength, DiffusionEmission or CostReduction is SOVEREIGNTY-SIDE: holding it means this nation could PRODUCE it, so operating an imported article does not qualify. Every other node is USE-SIDE: deployed and in operational use here is enough, whoever built it, because the effect such a node pays is a productivity, health or output effect and that effect is real in the country where the machine runs. Of the 48 technologies the tree lets anyone hold in 1990, 17 are sovereignty-side and 31 are use-side.

DATA-KEYED TAIL NATION. This nation is outside the 29 authored majors, so nothing here was authored technology by technology: a grant is made only where one of two named published global series supports it, and nothing is modelled, estimated or interpolated. A short list, or an empty one, is the correct outcome of that rule and not a gap in the work.

Data-keyed tail nation: not one of the 29 authored majors. Only the two series named in ruling 3 were consulted - WHO/UNICEF WUENIC DTP3 1990 and World Bank IT.CEL.SETS. Nothing was modelled, estimated or interpolated, and no other evidence was admitted. ISO3 key used for both series: PHL.
WUENIC DTP3 1990 = 88% against the 80% UCI-1990 threshold: bio_universal_immunisation GRANTED.
IT.CEL.SETS at 31 December 1989 = 0 against a threshold of any positive count: refused.

The other 46 grantable 1990 technologies are BLANK for this nation by design, not by oversight: the 17 sovereignty-side entries are unreachable by any use-in-operation series, and no published global series was named that keys the remaining 29 use-side entries.

Series value: PHL, 1990 = 88%, at or above the 80% WHO/UNICEF Universal Childhood Immunization (UCI-1990) target that defines this technology's name.
